segments.name: Fraud Prevention and Check Verification
segments.description: Provides digital identity verification, fraud prevention and check verification software and services to financial institutions, fintechs, telecoms and digital marketplaces.
segments.evidence: The Company provides software and service offerings focused on fraud prevention and check verification.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay for time-based software licenses, SaaS usage or minimum commitments, maintenance, and consulting and professional services.
